test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If interest be compounded half - yearly, then find the compound interest on ₹8,000 at 20% p.a. for 1 year.
solution:
Given :

Principal P = 8000

Rate r = 20% per annum = 10% half - yearly

Time n = 1 year = 2 half - year

Formula Used :

C I = P [(1 + r/100)n&nb
